lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我叫王明。单人间，住两晚。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng. Dānrénjiān, zhù liǎng wǎn.
lines.english: My name is Wang Ming. Single room, staying two nights.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 好的，王先生。这是您的钥匙，305房间。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, Wáng xiānsheng. Zhè shì nín de yàoshi, 305 fángjiān.
lines.english: OK, Mr. Wang. Here is your key, room 305.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 早上七点到九点半。在一楼餐厅。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshang qī diǎn dào jiǔ diǎn bàn. Zài yī lóu cāntīng.
lines.english: 7:00 to 9:30 AM. In the first floor restaurant.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thanks. What is the WiFi password?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 密码写在桌子上的卡片上。祝您住得愉快！
lines.pinyin: Mìmǎ xiě zài zhuōzi shàng de kǎipiàn shàng. Zhù nín zhù de yúkuài!
lines.english: The password is on the card on the desk. Hope you have a pleasant stay!
